common_targets.decision_clock: after official close value for session t is published and available
common_targets.label_rule: FLAT if abs(r)<=1e-8; UP if r>1e-8; DOWN if r< -1e-8
common_targets.eligible_output: three probabilities ordered DOWN, FLAT, UP and summing to 1 within 1e-8
common_targets.brier_formula: sum_k((p_k - I[y=k])^2) over DOWN, FLAT, UP, no division by class count
common_targets.baseline: expanding training-only class frequency with Laplace alpha=1, recomputed causally at every decision time
common_targets.evaluation_alignment: all candidates at a given horizon use identical decision timestamps and label endpoints

common_targets.evaluation_alignment: all candidates at a given horizon use identical decision timestamps and target endpoints

common_targets.evaluation_alignment: all candidates use identical decision timestamps and target endpoints

paper_native_tasks.rule: Record each native target, split, horizon and metric with source locators. If source definition is ambiguous, mark AMBIGUOUS or BLOCKED_METHOD. Native paper-reported metrics may be descriptive; do not pool incompatible label schemas or endpoints into the common family.
examples: Mehtab-Sen one-week close_norm prediction and binary movement classification
Cureus next-session open/close price tasks and native 5/10/20-year windows
IJSDR claimed next-30-day prediction with undefined accuracy
JRFM next-30-day price task and BE-LSTM
ISMLA option-like dataset with unresolved target schema

point_in_time_rules.daily_ohlcv: Available only after the official close value is published; pre-close decisions use the last completed session.
point_in_time_rules.training_label_end: Every training row label_endpoint_timestamp must be strictly earlier than the decision_timestamp.
point_in_time_rules.fii_dii: Use publication/availability timestamp, not only event date; rows without defensible timestamp require a predeclared lag or exclusion.
point_in_time_rules.vix_options: Snapshot captured no later than decision cutoff; contract and expiry mapping must be point-in-time.
point_in_time_rules.news_social: Both original publication timestamp and ingestion timestamp must precede cutoff; date-only same-day items are excluded unless a fixed lag is predeclared; revisions do not backdate availability.
point_in_time_rules.revisions: Preserve vintage metadata; if history cannot be reconstructed, mark adapted/limited rather than exact PIT replication.

inference.test: one-sided familywise max-studentized-mean-improvement test; positive improvement favors the candidate
inference.observed_statistic: T_obs=max_j(mean(d[,j])/SE_boot[j]) where SE_boot[j] is the sample standard deviation of bootstrap means for the null-centered loss differential
inference.null_centering: Before resampling, for every candidate j form d0[i,j]=d[i,j]-mean(d[,j]); resample d0 under the zero-mean null
inference.resampling: moving-block bootstrap over chronological decision-origin rows; in each replicate use the same sampled block indexes for every candidate and horizon within a family to preserve cross-candidate and cross-horizon dependence
inference.block_length_sessions: max(5, horizon_sessions) for each decision-origin block; specify the exact numeric length per family/horizon in the frozen manifest
inference.bootstrap_statistic: For each replicate b compute mean(d0_star[,j]) for each candidate; T_star[b]=max_j(mean(d0_star[,j])/SE_boot[j])
inference.simultaneous_95pct_ci: Use c95=95th percentile of max_j(abs(mean(d0_star[,j])/SE_boot[j])); candidate j interval is mean(d[,j]) +/- c95*SE_boot[j]. Also report unadjusted percentile bootstrap intervals as descriptive only.
inference.missing_candidate_rule: If any pre-frozen confirmatory candidate/horizon lacks sufficient rows, valid predictions, finite loss or positive finite SE, mark the whole family INCOMPLETE_NOT_PROMOTABLE; report available cells descriptively but do not issue a confirmatory family p-value or promote a candidate. Exclusions for unavailable sources must be decided before the manifest is frozen and recorded as BLOCKED_DATA.
inference.undefined_metrics: Store null with reason code; never coerce undefined values to zero or silently drop a planned candidate.
inference.repeated_evaluation_rule: No additions to confirmatory families after any evaluation outcome is inspected; amendments are exploratory unless reviewed before the first fit.

search_bounds.budget_rule: The frozen manifest must calculate its expected fit calls, including inner-fold fits, seed repeats and refits, and fail validation if it exceeds the global cap.
